title: HSK1 Gate 6 · Western Han
explanationEn: Gate 6: Western Han. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第6关：西汉。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 汉朝的时候，中国和西边很少来往。汉朝的人向西走了很远。路很长，走一次要很多个月。他们带着中国的丝绸去做买卖。
passageEn: In the Han dynasty, China and the lands to the west had little contact. Han Dynasty people walked very far towards the west. The road was long; one journey took many months. They carried Chinese silk to trade.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Han dynasty, China and the lands to the west had little contact.
comprehension.answer: 汉朝的时候，中国和西边很少来往。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: The road was long; one journey took many months.
comprehension.answer: 路很长，走一次要很多个月。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Western Han in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说西汉。
